title: pm-dispatch: a merge-tree overlap check replaces "hot file, one writer" at claim and push time
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9NQgBevLnvWc2PiVm5MsaJE)_

Fixes #33941

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：新增 `scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`,对一个分支与 origin/main 及每个共享文件的 open PR 跑 `git merge-tree`,列出冲突文件;area-lease.md 改为认领前、推前跑它，只有真文本重叠才排队。
- 为什么改：您 2026-11-15 在热文件串行决策卡上选了「今天改规则,并立全部 6 张卡」,本卡是卡 A——同文件不再一律一人写，减少车队无谓排队。
- 风险与回滚：只动仓内 PM 工具与 .claude 文本，不发布、不进 CI;回滚即 revert 本 PR。脚本答不出(浅克隆、API 读不到)一律 exit 3,不会误报「无重叠」。
- 先看：`scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` 的 `runOnce()`(哪些冲突算你的)与 `mergeTree()`(为何用空 attr-source);`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md` 新增三行。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --self-test`,应见「26 cases in 7 batteries pass」。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地(.claude/** 为 Tier S,达档 L2 PASS 后由席位落地)。

## What changes

**1. `scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` (new, dependency-free).** For a branch (default `HEAD`) it runs `git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only` against the base (default `origin/main`) and against the head of every open PR whose files meet the branch's own change set, and lists the conflicting files per side.

- Exit codes: `0` no textual overlap · `1` overlap (files listed) · `2` usage · `3` cannot answer (no merge base in a shallow clone, an unreadable PR list, a PR head that will not fetch). Exit 3 is an addition to the card's three codes: without it, "could not look" would have to share a code with an answer. Its remedy line names the fix (`git fetch --deepen=1500 origin main`).
- Candidates: `GET /repos/{repo}/pulls?state=open` plus each PR's `/files` (renames count by both names), paged through the existing `gh-pages.mjs` reader; the branch's own PR (same head ref or sha) and `--exclude-pr` are skipped. `--pr=N[,N]` names the candidates instead and reads nothing from the API.
- PR heads are fetched into a namespace the tool owns: `+refs/pull/N/head:refs/overlap-check/pull/N`.
- Which PR-head conflicts count is decided by evidence, not by path name. A conflict on a file the branch changed is the branch's own. A conflict on any other path is "not yours" only when the base merged with that PR head conflicts on the same path: a PR built on an older main meets that conflict whatever this branch does. Everything else counts. So a PR that renames the file the branch edits counts, though git reports its conflict under the new name, outside the branch's change set. When in doubt the tool answers overlap.
- Exit 1 lines name whom to queue behind. A base conflict is no queue: merge the base. A PR-head conflict queues the branch behind that PR until it lands. Before a claim with no commits, the change set is empty and the answer is 0 by construction; the header says so and points at `--branch=`.
- Fetched PR heads under `refs/overlap-check/pull/` are deleted again before the run returns (self-test pins it).
- **Every merge-tree runs as `git --attr-source=EMPTY_TREE merge-tree …`.** `.gitattributes` routes generated artifacts to the `os-regen` merge driver, which exits 0 and leaves no marker. The self-test measures the trap: with a driver that resolves everything registered for the file, a plain `git merge-tree` exits 0 on a real two-branch conflict, while the tool still reports it. The empty attribute source gives the plain three-way text merge the merge queue performs, and writes no `os-regen-pending` into the shared `.git/`. It differs from AGENTS.md §11's mergeability probe (a throwaway bare clone with no driver) on purpose: the question here is only which paths conflict, answered in place without a second clone, and the self-test holds it to a driver-ON control leg.

**2. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md`** — three lines in, three out (71 lines, ceiling 71, headroom 0; the ratchet row is unchanged):

- `Pre-claim deps:` no longer serializes on a hot file; it points to the new overlap-check line: run the tool before a claim and before every push, on exit 1 queue behind the PR it lists, and on exit 3 meet the prerequisite and re-run.
- A card in the same series may start on the previous card's branch, in the AGENTS.md Multi-agent discipline §2 trunk form, with no stacked PR. AGENTS.md rules a stacked series out, and AGENTS.md wins over this file.
- New tests go in a new file named by card. The exception is the AGENTS.md shared-harness rule (ruling record 6583487846); when it applies, the overlap check decides the queueing. This wording follows the scope note on the card (comment 6896403681).

Lines paid, each with its surviving home:

| removed line | surviving home |
|:---|:---|
| `dev 开 PR 前自查申报:os-dev.md〈Definition of done〉,BREAKING/ADR-0087 照 AGENTS.md Post-Task 第 3 条。` (a pointer) | `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` 〈Definition of done〉 binds every dev unconditionally; AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist item 3 |
| `关卡照 execution-duties.md:⛔ 不凭本区读数自关。` | `execution-duties.md:62` (已修交分诊或维护者关,⛔ 不自关); the W0 list itself is acted on only after the maintainer's pass (`area-lease.md` W0 sub-line) |
| `旧号移座照 seat-lifecycle.md 移座行。` (a pointer) | `seat-lifecycle.md:43` (移座) |

No ceiling was raised: the maintainer's hot-file ruling has no GitHub ruling-record id this PR could quote, so every new line is paid by a deletion.

## Tests

- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --self-test` → `✓ overlap-check self-test: 26 cases in 7 batteries pass.` It builds real git repositories in a temp dir: a bare remote carrying `refs/pull/7/head` (a real conflict on `a.txt` line 2), `refs/pull/8/head` (same file, another hunk: clean) and `refs/pull/9/head` (disjoint file: clean), `refs/pull/10/head` (renames `a.txt` to `moved.txt` and edits the same line), a moved main, and a branch on the moved main. Batteries: argv; a real two-branch conflict; no conflict (same file other hunk, disjoint files); a registered merge driver does not hide the conflict (with a control leg showing plain merge-tree exits 0); candidate selection (shared files only, own PR skipped by ref and by sha, renames); paged open-PR reads with a failed read refused; CLI end to end (exit 1 on #7, 0 on #8 and #9, 1 on a base conflict, 1 on the rename #10 with `moved.txt` counted as yours, 0 when the only conflict is one #7 has with the moved main itself, no fetched ref left behind, 2 on usage, 3 with no merge base). It follows the AGENTS.md self-test shape: a literal battery roster with per-battery floors, a roster-size pin, and a verdict handshake.
- Ablation at `9908d7eda`, mutation landed and checked by `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: replacing `const notYours = elsewhere.filter((f) => theirs.includes(f));` with `const notYours = elsewhere;` (path-name classification, the shape the L2 review found) turns the self-test red on exactly one case, the rename one (`exit 1`, `1 failure(s)`). Restored: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty; the re-run is `26 cases … pass`.
- A fixture bug in the first run (the root commit) made every battery register 0 cases, and the floor refused all seven by name. That shows the floor fails when nothing runs.
- Live, on this checkout: `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=refs/overlap-check/pull/34110 --exclude-pr=34110` read all 52 open PRs and found one candidate (#34266, which shares `triage-duties.md`), which merges cleanly, so the run exited 0 in 35 s. The same run before `git fetch --deepen=1500 origin main` answered exit 3 with the deepen remedy, not a verdict.

## Acceptance notes

- Not wired to CI — a new gate defaults to no and the maintainer has not named one; the self-test is local only: `dispatch-gates --commands` on this branch does not derive `overlap-check.mjs --self-test` (measured at `5d8e2161d`, 36 commands, none of them this file).
- Accepted as written (L2 nit N2): the same-series line already says `⛔ 不叠 PR` beside the AGENTS.md §2 trunk form; the line has no bytes left to say more.
- The serial wording elsewhere is not on this card's file surface and still stands (`execution-duties.md`, `SKILL.md`, the 热文件串行队 in `seat-post-protocol.md` and `seat-lifecycle.md`); the follow-up is #34527. The new rule binds area-lease mode only.
- Uncommitted work is not seen: the tool reads commits. Its header says to commit before asking.

## Verification

Derived gates at the final head `5d8e2161d` (round 2, after merging `origin/main`): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` listed 36, and all 36 exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: `36 derived, 36 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. `check:doc-formula-expressions` ran on `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` output built under the verify lock (VERDICT command-exit 0); the merge touched neither package. `area-lease.md` stays 71/71 and its reworded line is 118 bytes.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (CI owns the repo-wide lint run)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset — nothing publishes here (`scripts/pm/**`, `.claude/**`): `skip-changeset`.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
